mapper.insert: insert into elder_health_info(elder_id, self_care, vision, hearing, hospital, doctor, hospital_phone, allergy_drug, medical_history, major_disease, create_by, remark, create_time) values (#{elderId}, #{selfCare}, #{vision}, #{hearing}, #{hospital}, #{doctor}, #{hospitalPhone}, #{allergyDrug}, #{medicalHistory}, #{majorDisease}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
